title: `prompts/get`
description: Resolves one prompt with arguments into a list of messages, each with a role and a content block.
question: Can the agent resolve a prompt into messages it can actually send?
notes: Both adapters that reach 2026-07-28 expose it; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Resolvable to messages by both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 returns `GetPromptResult` with its description and messages. Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns a `PromptResult` whose `PromptMessage` keeps the role and text content. In both cases the agent receives something it can send. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: A prompt is only useful once it is expanded. This row is where a framework either produces messages in its own conversation format or hands back a structure the caller has to translate by hand.
